mathematical_scope: Phase15 archive builder embedding previous phase14 checkpoint and two original uploaded materials. No mathematical algorithm.
input_and_guard_coverage: Hard-coded /mnt/data paths; absent files fail during read. Recursively selected current files exclude bytecode/cache and prior manifest. No expected ancestor/original-upload digest is embedded in source. Top-level imports execute writes if imported, so inert reading was essential.
cost_and_scaling: Hashing/ZIP construction and verification read complete payloads repeatedly. Full ancestor embedding dominates long checkpoint chains; peak verification memory at least the largest member.
test_evidence: Checks ZIP CRC and compares each stored member to the current file bytes, stronger than the phase17 packager. This remains subject to source changes between manifest creation, write and verification. No package built here.
dependency_identity: pathlib/zipfile/hashlib plus four external hard-coded inputs and current folder contents; their existence/content not established by this source read.

findings.finding: A source mutation after manifest generation but before ZIP writing can leave a stale manifest while the archive-versus-current-file equality passes. Verification should compare archived bytes to archived manifest hashes, using one fixed input snapshot.
The final preservation flags test dictionary-key membership, not an expected version/hash. They establish intended inclusion, not ancestor identity.

acceptance_boundary: Accept packaging intent and stronger byte-comparison design; no preservation result or specific produced archive is certified by source inspection.
